verdict.rationale: Cloudflare Sandboxes is a programmatic SDK with no UI requirement, so it runs headlessly by design. `sandbox.exec()` returns stdout, stderr and exit codes, sessions support default command timeouts, and Git operations can be automated. The docs also name CI/CD systems as a target use case. missing for 10: a documented way to drive sandboxes directly from an external CI runner (for example a CLI or GitHub Actions integration rather than only via a deployed Worker), and independent or hands-on corroboration of CI usage.
